record.question: Entry of secondary code number on the last column of primary index card and entry of primary code number in the last column of secondary index card is:
record.explanation: Answer D: Cross indexing. Cross-indexing records a secondary diagnosis code on the primary index card and vice versa, creating links in both directions. Reference: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/208125/9290610050_rev_eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
